title: Jerkily Tender Mexican Steak Burrito
description: Fermented, silky, and cozy Sonoran-style burrito featuring lean minced steak, tagine-cooked for a low-calorie-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Lean Minced Steak
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with high protein content and minimal fat.

ingredients.name: Cumin Seeds
ingredients.notes: Grind or toast for added depth.

ingredients.name: Coriander Seeds
ingredients.notes: Grind or toast for added warmth.

ingredients.name: Bergamot Juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh or bottled for a bright, citrusy flavor.

ingredients.name: Cocoa Powder
ingredients.notes: Believe it or not, a pinch of cocoa powder enhances the umami taste.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a mild or medium-strength oil for balance.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince or crush for an aromatic flavor.

ingredients.name: Fermented Pepper Paste
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought for added umami.

ingredients.name: Shredded Lettuce
ingredients.notes: Choose a crisp variety for crunch.

ingredients.name: Monterey Jack Cheese
ingredients.notes: Shredded for an evenly melted texture.

instructions: In a large skillet or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
